name: Boarding: people, discoveries and stories
notes: Boarding stage B3 (docs/BOARDING.md): the words of the people met aboard another vessel and of the places on it. 28 events of type boarding_npc (survivors.json 5, hermits.json 6, traders.json 6, scavengers.json 4, captives.json 3, touched.json 4: one with fallback true for every role, so a talk always has something to say; survivors, hermits, traders and the Hollow-touched are met in stations and derelicts, a scavenger who talks first as well, a captive in a pirate nest) and 18 of type boarding_site (discoveries.json, ten of them generic and none tied to a faction: a terminal, a body or a room that is marked on a site, shown the first time he steps into its room). Picked by requires.site, role, theme (data/boarding.json themes), region, stage and flags. Their effects are npc_trade, npc_reveal, npc_join (bnpc_survivor_pulled_through, bnpc_trader_lost_partner and bnpc_captive_cut_free: they are recruit events, so the region's one free offer and the species gate apply), npc_hostile, npc_follow, npc_leave and site_fight (events.gd). Six events carry the story spine: the Haven trail (bnpc_survivor_lantern_chalk sets haven_2, bsite_relay_terminal haven_3, bnpc_trader_radio haven_4), the Hollow trail (bsite_room_eleven_chairs hollow_1, bnpc_touched_roll_call hollow_2) and the doors (bnpc_hermit_ledger doors_known), each with its log from endings_1 and story_1, so it needs story_1. logs.json adds nine logs that these events hand out; any of them may also lie in a container aboard. No event recruits except the three named above; none fights, boards or ends the run.
